ITEM 1 | Bright yellow cubes with pale yellow flesh and slightly glossy, juicy-looking cut faces, roughly 2-3 cm pieces with a cut edge, scattered across the left half of the plate, covering about 30% of the plate | 180
ITEM 2 | Small golden-brown cubes with crisp, browned and slightly charred edges and a dry, roasted surface, about 1-1.5 cm pieces, clustered in the center-left of the plate next to the yellow cubes, covering about 10% of the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Dark green, wrinkled, rounded clusters with brownish-edged leaves and a matte, slightly glossy surface, about 2-3 cm each, grouped on the upper right of the plate, covering about 10% of the plate | 70
ITEM 4 | Opaque white, flaky-looking piece with slightly translucent edges and a light dusting of black pepper specks on top, soft and moist, about 6 x 4 cm and 1.5 cm thick, sitting at the center-right of the plate, covering about 8% of the plate | 90
ITEM 5 | Fine white crumbly mound with a loose, grainy, slightly moist texture and small irregular clumps, about 5 x 4 cm and 2 cm high, placed at the far right edge of the plate, covering about 5% of the plate | 60
